ledger: Station wagon | parked on desert roadside, oriented toward front-left | zoomed-in view of hood, cowl, and cabin front | remains stationary as camera dollies in
Woman | leaning with crossed arms on the front-left fender/hood area | close-up in the same spot | turns head slightly toward the right while hair blows in wind
Desert road and mountains | visible behind and to the left of the car | out of focus in background | perspective shifts smoothly with camera push-in

findings.invariant_violated: depth ordering & occlusion / impossible scene geometry
findings.description: The woman occupies an impossible geometric position relative to the vehicle's structure: her torso emerges directly upward through the solid metal hood and cowl in front of the driver-side A-pillar, with the windshield glass behind her back, the closed side window behind her left shoulder, and the solid front fender occluding her waist.
